title: Narrative Style — Direct ↔ Indirect Speech
lede: চারটি জিনিস বদলায় — reporting verb, person, tense, আর সময়-স্থানসূচক শব্দ। বাক্যের ধরন বুঝলেই বাকিটা নিয়মে চলে।

objectives.d: Reporting verb · Person · Tense · Adverb — এই চারটিই বদলায়
Subject → Object → No change — সহজ সূত্র
চিরন্তন সত্য ও reporting verb Present হলে

rules.name: The four things that change
rules.bn: উক্তি পরিবর্তনে বদলায় চারটি জিনিস — **(১) reporting verb, (২) person (সর্বনাম), (৩) tense, (৪) সময়-স্থানসূচক শব্দ**। বাকিটা প্রায় অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
rules.ex: He said to me, “I am busy.” → He told me that he was busy.

rules.name: Person change — the SON rule
rules.bn: **S-O-N সূত্র:** Reported speech-এর First Person → reporting verb-এর **S**ubject অনুযায়ী; Second Person → **O**bject অনুযায়ী; Third Person → **N**o change (অপরিবর্তিত)।
rules.ex: He said to me, “==I== shall help ==you==.” → He told me that ==he== would help ==me==.

rules.name: Tense change — the backshift
rules.bn: Reporting verb **Past** হলে reported speech এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়: Present→Past, Past→Past Perfect, Present Perfect→Past Perfect, will→would, can→could, may→might, shall→should।
rules.formula: am/is→was · are→were · V1→V2 · V2→had+V3 · will→would · can→could
rules.ex: He said, “I ==am== ill.” → He said that he ==was== ill.

rules.name: When the tense does NOT change
rules.bn: দুই ক্ষেত্রে tense অপরিবর্তিত থাকে — **(ক)** reporting verb যদি **Present বা Future** হয়; **(খ)** reported speech যদি **চিরন্তন সত্য, অভ্যাসগত সত্য বা ঐতিহাসিক সত্য** হয়।
rules.formula: Present reporting verb → no change · Universal truth → no change
rules.ex: He says, “The earth ==moves== round the sun.” → He says that the earth ==moves== round the sun.

rules.name: Adverb / word change
rules.bn: সময় ও স্থানসূচক শব্দ দূরত্ব বোঝাতে বদলে যায় — **now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next day, yesterday→the previous day, here→there, this→that, these→those, ago→before, thus→so**।
rules.formula: now→then · here→there · this→that · today→that day · tomorrow→the next day
rules.ex: He said, “I will come ==tomorrow==.” → He said that he would come ==the next day==.

rules.name: Assertive sentence (বিবৃতিমূলক)
rules.bn: সাধারণ বিবৃতির ক্ষেত্রে reporting verb **said → said**, **said to → told**; সংযোজক হিসেবে **that** বসে।
rules.formula: sub + told + object + that + reported speech
rules.ex: He said to me, “I am happy.” → He ==told me that== he was happy.

rules.name: Interrogative — Wh-question
rules.bn: প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে reporting verb হয় **asked / enquired of**; wh-word নিজেই সংযোজক, তাই that বসে না। বাক্যটি **assertive গঠনে** (subject + verb) লিখতে হয় এবং শেষে দাঁড়ি।
rules.ex: He said to me, “Where do you live?” → He ==asked me where I lived==.

rules.name: Interrogative — Yes/No question
rules.bn: Wh-word না থাকলে সংযোজক হিসেবে **if / whether** বসে; বাকিটা assertive গঠনে।
rules.formula: asked + object + if / whether + sub + verb
rules.ex: He said to me, “Are you ill?” → He ==asked me if I was ill==.

rules.name: Imperative — order / request / advice
rules.bn: আদেশ = **ordered**, অনুরোধ = **requested**, উপদেশ = **advised**, নিষেধ = **forbade / told not to**। Reported অংশ **to + V1** রূপে যায়।
rules.formula: ordered / requested / advised + object + to + V1
rules.ex: He said to me, “Go home.” → He ==ordered me to go== home.

rules.name: Negative imperative
rules.formula: told / forbade + object + not to + V1
rules.ex: He said to me, “Don't waste time.” → He ==told me not to waste== time.

rules.name: ‘Let us’ — proposal
rules.bn: **Let us / Let's** দিয়ে প্রস্তাব বোঝালে reporting verb হয় **proposed / suggested**, সংযোজক **that**, এবং পরে **should + V1**।
rules.formula: proposed / suggested + that + sub + should + V1
rules.ex: He said, “Let us go for a walk.” → He ==proposed that we should go== for a walk.

rules.name: Optative sentence (প্রার্থনা / কামনা)
rules.bn: ইচ্ছা বা প্রার্থনা বোঝালে reporting verb হয় **wished / prayed**, সংযোজক **that**, এবং পরে **might** বসে।
rules.formula: wished / prayed + that + sub + might + V1
rules.ex: He said, “May you live long.” → He ==prayed that I might live== long.

rules.name: Exclamatory sentence (আবেগসূচক)
rules.bn: আবেগ বোঝালে reporting verb হয় **exclaimed with joy / sorrow / wonder**, সংযোজক **that**; What a / How উঠে গিয়ে **very / great** বসে।
rules.formula: exclaimed with joy / sorrow + that + sub + verb
rules.ex: He said, “What a fine bird it is!” → He ==exclaimed with wonder that it was a very fine bird==.

rules.name: Sir / Madam / Friends — address words
rules.bn: সম্বোধনসূচক শব্দ থাকলে reporting verb-এ তা মিশে যায় — **Sir → respectfully / addressing him respectfully**, **Friends → addressing them as friends**।
rules.ex: He said, “Sir, I am innocent.” → He ==respectfully said that== he was innocent.

rules.name: Two sentences of different types
rules.bn: একই উক্তিতে দুই ধরনের বাক্য থাকলে প্রতিটির জন্য **আলাদা reporting verb** ব্যবহার করে **and / but** দিয়ে যুক্ত করতে হয়।
rules.ex: He said to me, “I am busy. Can you wait?” → He ==told me that he was busy and asked me whether I could wait==.

rules.name: Yes / No in the answer
rules.bn: উত্তরে **Yes / No** থাকলে তা **replied in the affirmative / replied in the negative** হয়ে যায়।
rules.formula: replied in the affirmative / negative + that + …
rules.ex: He said, “Yes, I know him.” → He ==replied in the affirmative that== he knew him.

boardQ.instruction: Change the following conversation into indirect speech. — নিচের সংলাপটি পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে রূপান্তর করো। (5)
boardQ.text: Rahim said to Karim, “Where are you going now?” Karim said, “I am going to the library. Will you come with me?” Rahim said, “No, I am busy today. Please help me with my homework tomorrow.” Karim said, “Certainly. May you do well in the exam!”

items.ans: Rahim asked Karim where he was going then.
items.why: Wh-question → **asked**; wh-word নিজেই সংযোজক; ‘now’ → **then**; are going → was going. (নিয়ম ০৭, ০৫)

items.ans: Karim replied that he was going to the library
items.why: Assertive → **replied/said that**; ‘I’ → he (subject অনুযায়ী); am → was. (নিয়ম ০৬, ০২, ০৩)

items.ans: and asked him if he would come with him.
items.why: Yes/No question → **asked … if**; will → **would**; ‘you’ → him (object অনুযায়ী)। (নিয়ম ০৮, ০২)

items.ans: Rahim replied in the negative
items.why: উত্তরে ‘No’ → **replied in the negative**. (নিয়ম ১৬)

items.ans: and said that he was busy that day.
items.why: Assertive; ‘today’ → **that day**. (নিয়ম ০৫)

items.ans: He requested him to help him with his homework the next day.
items.why: ‘Please’ থাকায় অনুরোধ → **requested + to + V1**; tomorrow → **the next day**. (নিয়ম ০৯, ০৫)

items.ans: Karim replied in the affirmative
items.why: ‘Certainly’ = সম্মতি → affirmative. (নিয়ম ১৬)

items.ans: and wished that he might do well in the exam.
items.why: ‘May you…’ → Optative → **wished that … might + V1**. (নিয়ম ১২)

items.ans: ‘you’ → him / he — কেন?
items.why: Second person reported speech-এ reporting verb-এর **object** অনুযায়ী বদলায় (SON সূত্রের O)। (নিয়ম ০২)

items.ans: ‘now / today / tomorrow’ কেন বদলাল?
items.why: বক্তার সময় থেকে দূরত্ব বোঝাতে — now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next day. (নিয়ম ০৫)

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — বাক্যের ধরন চেনা
drills.intro: আগে বলো এটি কোন ধরনের বাক্য (assertive / interrogative / imperative / optative / exclamatory), তারপর reporting verb।

items.q: He said to me, “I am reading a book.”
items.ans: He told me that he was reading a book.
items.why: Assertive → said to = told, that, am → was. (০৬, ০৩)

items.q: She said to him, “What are you doing?”
items.ans: She asked him what he was doing.
items.why: Wh-question → asked; that বসে না; assertive গঠন। (০৭)

items.q: He said to me, “Do you know him?”
items.ans: He asked me if I knew him.
items.why: Yes/No question → asked … if; do you know → I knew. (০৮)

items.q: The teacher said to us, “Work hard.”
items.ans: The teacher advised us to work hard.
items.why: উপদেশমূলক imperative → advised + to + V1. (০৯)

items.q: He said to me, “Don't tell a lie.”
items.ans: He told me not to tell a lie.
items.why: Negative imperative → not to + V1. (১০)

items.ans: He prayed that Allah might bless me.
items.why: Optative → prayed that … might. (১২)

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — Tense, Person ও Adverb
drills.intro: এই সেটে চারটি পরিবর্তনই একসাথে যাচাই হবে।

items.ans: He said that he had gone there the previous day.
items.why: Past → Past Perfect; yesterday → the previous day. (০৩, ০৫)

items.q: He says, “The sun rises in the east.”
items.ans: He says that the sun rises in the east.
items.why: Reporting verb Present + চিরন্তন সত্য → tense বদলায় না। (০৪)

items.q: He said to me, “I shall help you.”
items.ans: He told me that he would help me.
items.why: shall → would; ‘I’→he (subject), ‘you’→me (object)। (০২, ০৩)

items.ans: He proposed that we should play football.
items.why: Let us → proposed that … should + V1. (১১)

items.q: He said, “How beautiful the scenery is!”
items.ans: He exclaimed with wonder that the scenery was very beautiful.
items.why: Exclamatory → exclaimed with wonder that; How → very. (১৩)

items.q: He said, “Sir, I am not guilty.”
items.ans: He respectfully said that he was not guilty.
items.why: ‘Sir’ → respectfully; বাকিটা assertive. (১৪)

extras.title: Sentence type → Reporting verb — কোন ধরনে কোন verb ও সংযোজক
extras.note: **পরীক্ষার নিয়ম:** আগে বাক্যের ধরন চেনো → এই ছক থেকে reporting verb ও সংযোজক নাও → তারপর person, tense, adverb বদলাও।

extras.title: The change tables — Person · Tense · Adverb
extras.note: **Tense বদলায় না** যদি reporting verb Present/Future হয়, অথবা reported speech চিরন্তন সত্য হয়।

tips.d: Assertive? প্রশ্ন? আদেশ? প্রার্থনা? আবেগ? — ধরন ঠিক করলেই reporting verb ও সংযোজক নির্ধারিত হয়ে যায়।
**S**ubject → **O**bject → **N**o change। First person subject অনুযায়ী, second person object অনুযায়ী, third person অপরিবর্তিত।

tips.t: Backshift only if reporting verb is Past
tips.d: ‘He says…’ হলে tense বদলাবে না। চিরন্তন সত্যেও বদলাবে না — এই দুটি ব্যতিক্রম মনে রাখো।
Indirect-এ প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন থাকে না; বাক্যটি assertive গঠনে (subject + verb) লিখে শেষে দাঁড়ি দিতে হয়।
একই উক্তিতে বিবৃতি ও প্রশ্ন থাকলে ‘told … that … and asked … whether …’ — দুটি আলাদা verb লাগবে।
Indirect speech-এ উদ্ধৃতিচিহ্ন, কমা কিছুই থাকে না। রেখে দিলে নম্বর কাটা যায়।

recap: চারটি পরিবর্তন: reporting verb, person, tense, adverb।
Tense backshift কেবল reporting verb Past হলে; চিরন্তন সত্যে নয়।
Wh-question-এ that বসে না; Yes/No প্রশ্নে if/whether বসে; প্রশ্নচিহ্ন উঠে যায়।
homework: ‘Sentence type → Reporting verb’ ছকের ১০টি সারি মুখস্থ করবে।
Person · Tense · Adverb-এর ১৮টি পরিবর্তন খাতায় লিখবে।
বোর্ডের সংলাপটি না দেখে আবার রূপান্তর করবে।
নিজে একটি ৬ লাইনের সংলাপ লিখে তা indirect-এ রূপান্তর করবে।
